fields.name: indexPath
fields.label: Query Index Path
fields.description: The query-index.json URL to list from (e.g. /us/en/newsroom/press-releases/query-index.json).

fields.name: filterPrefix
fields.label: Path Filter Prefix
fields.description: Optional. Only list entries whose path starts with this prefix. Leave blank to list everything in the index.

fields.name: pageSize
fields.label: Items Per Page
fields.description: How many items to show initially and per 'Load more' click.
